info.name: Get historical USD flows for an address

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.

params.name: address
params.description: The blockchain address to query flow data for.

items.docs: Returns historical USD inflows, outflows, and cumulative totals for the specified address across supported chains.

info.name: Get historical USD flows for an entity

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bitcoin'). If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.

params.name: entity
params.description: The entity ID to query flow data for.

items.docs: Returns historical USD inflows, outflows, and cumulative totals for the specified entity across supported chains.
